offers_products.reason: Bumble, BFF and Badoo dating/friend-finding apps are software products sold via in-app subscriptions and purchases.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from app subscriptions and in-app purchases, not work done for customers; software counts as product.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Individual members use Bumble Date and BFF apps and pay for premium subscriptions.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Users are individuals; advertising is minor and no business buyers are evident from the site.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue comes from recurring weekly or monthly premium subscriptions to its dating apps.

cyclical_demand.reason: Discretionary premium dating subscriptions are easily cancelled or cut by consumers when budgets tighten.

big_ticket.reason: Small, frequent subscription payments for app premium features.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for app technology and network of members, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Buyers are individual consumers using dating and friendship apps.

asset_heavy.reason: Asset-light mobile app business needing software development and marketing, not plants or fleets.
